// CASE ts_honest expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
// CASE ts_distinct_template expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    consume(await step(item), `${await save(item)}`);
  }
}
// CASE ts_distinct_as expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    consume(await step(item), (await save(item)) as unknown as string);
  }
}
// CASE ts_distinct_nonnull expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    consume(await step(item), (await save(item))!);
  }
}
// CASE ts_distinct_satisfies expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    consume(await step(item), (await save(item)) satisfies unknown);
  }
}
// CASE ts_distinct_generic_call expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    consume(await step(item), await save<T>(item));
  }
}
